title: Your First Weekend at California State University-Long Beach, Shared as Cards
description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe campus sequence built around named CSULB landmarks, study spaces, and cultural stops.

cards.entity_name: Campus Sign on Bellflower & Beach Drive
cards.title: Start at the Bellflower campus sign
cards.subtitle: Arrival point · Bellflower Boulevard & Beach Drive
cards.notes: Meet your weekend group at the signed campus entrance, take an arrival photo, then use the campus map to choose the next landmark.
cards.short_summary: A clearly named CSULB selfie-map stop for beginning an on-campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's self-guided campus selfie map lists the Campus Sign on Bellflower & Beach Drive as an iconic selfie site.
cards.source_title: CSULB Campus Self-Guided Map: Iconic Selfie Sites
cards.access_notes: Use the university's campus map for directions and observe posted campus access guidance.

cards.title: Get oriented at Walter Pyramid
cards.subtitle: Campus landmark · Athletics complex
cards.notes: Walk to the pyramid for a campus-scale landmark photo and identify nearby routes before continuing toward the cultural and student-life stops.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed CSULB landmark that anchors the first campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's self-guided campus selfie map lists Walter Pyramid as an iconic selfie site.
cards.source_title: CSULB Campus Self-Guided Map: Iconic Selfie Sites
cards.access_notes: Enjoy the exterior and check the venue calendar if planning to attend a scheduled event.

cards.entity_name: Richard and Karen Carpenter Performing Arts Center
cards.title: Check the Carpenter Center calendar
cards.subtitle: Arts stop · Carpenter Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Pause outside the performing arts center, look for current public program information, and save any age-appropriate event that fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A named performing-arts venue included on CSULB's campus selfie map.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's self-guided campus selfie map lists Carpenter Performing Arts Center as an iconic selfie site.
cards.source_title: CSULB Campus Self-Guided Map: Iconic Selfie Sites
cards.access_notes: Entry and ticket requirements depend on the individual performance; consult the venue's current event information.

cards.title: Reserve a garden visit
cards.subtitle: Campus garden · Reservation required
cards.notes: Make a free reservation before going, then take a quiet loop through the garden's paths and bridges at the confirmed visit time.
cards.short_summary: A 1.3-acre campus garden and living museum with free reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB states that reservations are required for the Earl Burns Miller Japanese Garden and that reservations are free.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required; the garden says hours vary and it is always closed Mondays and Tuesdays.

cards.entity_name: Carolyn Campagna Kleefeld Contemporary Art Museum
cards.title: See what is on view at the art museum
cards.subtitle: Campus museum · Contemporary and modern art
cards.notes: Check the current gallery hours and exhibition details, then plan a slow gallery visit or photograph the museum exterior if it is closed.
cards.short_summary: A CSULB art museum with exhibitions and education programs.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB says the University Art Museum creates exhibition and education programs for contemporary and modern art and that admission is free for all.
cards.source_title: Campus Life | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; check the museum's current gallery hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walk Friendship Walk together
cards.subtitle: Campus pedestrian route
cards.notes: Use this named walk as a connective stretch: compare class-building locations, take a group photo, and keep moving toward the student union.
cards.short_summary: A named pedestrian landmark on CSULB's self-guided campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's self-guided campus selfie map lists Friendship Walk as an iconic selfie site.
cards.source_title: CSULB Campus Self-Guided Map: Iconic Selfie Sites
cards.access_notes: Follow campus pedestrian signage and use the official map to connect this stop with nearby destinations.

cards.title: Find the University Student Union
cards.subtitle: Student-life stop · University Student Union
cards.notes: Walk through the union to locate student-facing services and check posted campus programming before settling on an afternoon or evening activity.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed student-life destination at the center of many campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's self-guided campus selfie map lists the University Student Union as an iconic selfie site.
cards.source_title: CSULB Campus Self-Guided Map: Iconic Selfie Sites
cards.access_notes: Building access and program availability vary; review current union signage or official schedules when you arrive.

cards.title: Pause by Lyman Lough Fountain
cards.subtitle: Campus landmark · Fountain stop
cards.notes: Use the fountain as a short reset: fill in directions for tomorrow, take a landmark photo, and choose your final study-space stop.
cards.short_summary: A named fountain featured on CSULB's self-guided campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's self-guided campus selfie map lists Lyman Lough Fountain as an iconic selfie site.
cards.source_title: CSULB Campus Self-Guided Map: Iconic Selfie Sites
cards.access_notes: Treat this as an outdoor landmark stop and follow posted campus rules around the fountain area.

cards.title: Make the library your planning base
cards.subtitle: Academic stop · University Library
cards.notes: Locate the library entrance and service points, then make a short plan for course materials, printing, and a return study session.
cards.short_summary: A named campus library and map-listed destination for an academic reset.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's visitor information identifies the campus as home to a library, and the self-guided campus selfie map lists University Library as an iconic selfie site.
cards.source_title: Visitors | California State University Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Check the library's current public and student service hours before planning a longer visit.

cards.title: Finish at the GO BEACH Sign
cards.subtitle: Closing photo stop · Campus landmark
cards.notes: End the first campus loop at the GO BEACH Sign, take a final group photo, and save the route for an easy repeat between classes.
cards.short_summary: A named CSULB photo landmark for closing out the weekend campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: CSULB's self-guided campus selfie map lists the GO BEACH Sign as an iconic selfie site.
cards.source_title: CSULB Campus Self-Guided Map: Iconic Selfie Sites
cards.access_notes: Use the official campus map to locate the sign and respect any nearby facility access controls.
